mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and decline in the unemployment rate signals an overheating economy with aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to hard landing risks.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in residential investment (housing starts) signals weakening consumer demand and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production over the past 3 months signals weakening manufacturing output and reduced corporate capacity utilization, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1,300,000 units in a month, it signals a contraction in residential demand that reduces consumer confidence and near-term economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST falls below 1300.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a federal funds rate above 5.0% signals aggressive inflation control that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during monetary tightening cycles with FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and industrial production signals a broad-based demand and supply contraction, indicating economic weakness that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
